provenance.producer: ffprobe packet PTS and presentation-frame identity timestamps
provenance.scope: Independent PTS-to-presentation-frame identity oracle. It does not certify the reader's reported packet durations or production timing windows.

notes.fr30.webm: Packet PTS are millisecond-quantized. 2/30 seconds maps to presentation frame 1 between .033 and .067. The ffprobe duration field does not certify the reader's duration bound.
notes.no-duration.webm: DefaultDuration is replaced in the synthetic bytes. Its raw final PTS identifies a frame but does not certify a terminal reader window.
